questions.contextText: Passage Summary (Q115–Q119): Climate change involves long-term temperature and weather shifts driven primarily by human burning of fossil fuels (coal, oil, gas), releasing heat-trapping greenhouse gases and causing gradual planetary warming known as global warming. Its effects include melting glaciers and polar ice caps, rising sea levels endangering coastal communities, more frequent and intense extreme weather events (heatwaves, floods, hurricanes), and disrupted agricultural productivity threatening food security. Tackling it requires international cooperation through frameworks like the Paris Agreement, which aims to keep global warming well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels by cutting carbon emissions, adopting renewables, and adapting to unavoidable changes.
questions.questionText: According to the passage, what is the primary objective of the Paris Agreement?

To limit global warming to below 2°C
